# DPDP Untangled

> DPDP Untangled is India's DPDP Act 2023 compliance advisory practice and consent-technology partner — assessments, architecture, enablement, and an outright-ownable consent management platform. Powered by truConsent.

DPDP Untangled ("DPDP, untangled.") is India's DPDP Act 2023 compliance advisory practice and consent-technology partner. We run DPDP Gap Assessments, provide fractional DPO-as-a-Service, design consent architecture, build the structured DPDR (Digital Personal Data Register) and CDJR (Customer Data Journey Registry) that underpin a defensible DPDPA compliance programme — and sell an outright-ownable Consent Management Platform codebase and deployment, for organisations that would rather own their consent infrastructure than rent it.

## Services
- [All Services](https://dpdpuntangled.com/services/): 16 specialist DPDP Act 2023 services across 4 lines — Assessments, Tech Architecture & Build, Training & Enablement, and Advisory & Ongoing Support.
- [Consent Management Platform — Codebase & Deployment](https://dpdpuntangled.com/services/consent-management-platform-codebase-deployment/): Flagship offering — a working CMP codebase deployed on your own infrastructure, source included, no recurring licence fee.
- [DPDP Gap Assessment](https://dpdpuntangled.com/services/dpdp-gap-assessment/): Our foundational diagnostic engagement, with a full [deep-dive section](https://dpdpuntangled.com/gap-assessment/) on methodology, scope, pricing and deliverables.

## DPDP Readiness Levels
- [Readiness Levels overview](https://dpdpuntangled.com/readiness/): A six-level maturity model (Unaware → Optimised) for benchmarking DPDPA compliance posture.

- [CDJR — Customer Data Journey Registry](https://dpdpuntangled.com/frameworks/cdjr/): The consent collection point mapping methodology.
